# worker-nodes

Worker node sizing and kubelet tuning

Stability: preview ([Compatibility](https://policystk.io/reference/compatibility/#element-stability))

```yaml
stack:
  workerNodes:
    enabled: true
```

## Optional pieces

Shipped with `enabled: false`. Turn one on in a values layer.

| Entry | Description | Turn on with |
|---|---|---|
| Policy [`machines`](#policy-machines) | Worker MachineSet sizing | `policies.machines.enabled: true` |
| Policy [`ready`](#policy-ready) | Reports NonCompliant until workers reach the requested count | `policies.ready.enabled: true` |

## Settings

Under `stack.workerNodes.config`. Maps merge across layers; lists are replaced whole.

| Key | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `replicas` | Replicas per worker MachineSet. Empty keeps the installer's value. | `''` |
| `instanceType` | AWS instance type. Empty keeps the installer's value. | `''` |
| `numCPUs` | vSphere vCPUs. Empty keeps the installer's value. | `''` |
| `numCoresPerSocket` | vSphere cores per socket | `''` |
| `memoryMiB` | vSphere memory in MiB | `''` |
| `maxPods` | Maximum pods per node | `250` |
| `systemReservedMemory` | Memory reserved for system daemons | `1Gi` |
| `systemReservedCpu` | CPU reserved for system daemons | `250m` |
| `kubeReservedMemory` | Memory reserved for the kubelet and container runtime | `512Mi` |
| `kubeReservedCpu` | CPU reserved for the kubelet and container runtime | `250m` |
| `evictionMemory` | Hard eviction threshold for available memory | `500Mi` |

## Policies

`<cluster>` is the ManagedCluster name, or hubName on the hub. `global.remediationAction: inform` overrides every action below.

Standards: NIST SP 800-53. Controls: CM-6 Configuration Settings. Categories: CM Configuration Management.

### Policy `config`

`config-worker-nodes-<cluster>`: Worker kubelet configuration.

| Template | Action | Severity | Renders | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `config-worker-kubelet` | enforce | medium | [worker-kubelet](converters/config/worker-kubelet.yaml) | KubeletConfig for the worker pool |

### Policy `machines`

`machines-worker-nodes-<cluster>`: Worker MachineSet sizing. Off by default; turn on with `policies.machines.enabled: true`.

| Template | Action | Severity | Renders | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `machines-scale` | enforce | medium | [scale](converters/machines/scale.yaml) | Scale and resize existing worker MachineSets |

### Policy `ready`

`ready-worker-nodes-<cluster>`: Reports NonCompliant until workers reach the requested count. Depends on `machines-worker-nodes-<cluster>`. Off by default; turn on with `policies.ready.enabled: true`.

| Template | Action | Severity | Renders | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ready-worker-replicas` | inform | medium | [worker-replicas](converters/ready/worker-replicas.yaml) | Worker MachineSet readiness |
